q: Explain why the hybrid P × Q is sterile.
Its chromosomes from P and from Q are not homologous, so they cannot pair in meiosis and the gametes get unbalanced sets.
Suggest how plant R arose from the hybrid.
The chromosome number doubled, for example when chromosomes were copied but the cell did not divide (or by non-disjunction in all chromosomes).
Every chromosome now has an identical partner to pair with in meiosis, so normal gametes are made.
Explain why R counts as a new species.
R crossed with P gives offspring with 27 chromosomes that are sterile, so R is reproductively isolated from its parents: speciation in a single step.
Tetraploid (4n, made of two sets from each parent species).
